# Mafia Verse

> Real-time multiplayer Mafia party game. Create a room, assign roles, and play with friends over voice or in the same room — no downloads required.

Mafia Verse is a browser-based social deduction game for groups of 6-20 players. A host creates a room, configures roles (Mafia, Detective, Doctor, Bodyguard, Vigilante, Mayor, Jester, Civilian), and shares a room code for friends to join from their own devices. The game alternates Night phases (role actions) and Day phases (discussion and voting) until one team wins.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://mafia-verse.onrender.com/): create or join a room
- [Leaderboard](https://mafia-verse.onrender.com/leaderboard): global win/loss stats
